concepts.label: foreign exchange settlement netting provision
concepts.description: settlement netting provision that is specific to foreign exchange contracts

concepts.label: formal organisation
concepts.description: organization that is recognized in some legal jurisdiction, with associated rights and responsibilities

concepts.label: formula
concepts.description: rule expressed in letters and symbols that consists of at least one expression

concepts.label: forty-eight months
concepts.description: duration of exactly forty-eight months, regardless of the length in days of a given calendar month, but typically 30 days

concepts.label: forward
concepts.description: derivative instrument that is privately negotiated between parties to buy the underlier at a specified future date at the price specified in the contract

concepts.label: forward contract adjustment method
concepts.description: method by which adjustments will be made to the contract should one or more of a number of extraordinary events occur

concepts.label: ForwardRateAgreement
concepts.description: agreement to exchange an interest rate commitment on a notional amount at a future date

concepts.label: forward start option
concepts.description: exotic option that is fully specified with respect to a set expiry date, underlying asset and other parameters, purchased and paid for on initiation, but that becomes active at a set activation date with a strike price determined at the time of activation

concepts.label: FpML Business Center Code Scheme
concepts.description: the coding scheme used to define a set of codes for municipalities, or business centers, or business day adjustments for FpML

concepts.label: fractional ownership interest
concepts.description: classification indicating that several parties may share in, and mitigate the risk of, ownership of a high-value tangible asset

concepts.label: Fredericton
concepts.description: the international business center of Fredericton

concepts.description: the international business center of Freetown

concepts.description: negotiable commodity that is a freight index route

concepts.description: the country of French Southern Territories (the)

concepts.label: Friday
concepts.description: time interval that has duration 1 day and that meets a Saturday

concepts.label: from the end
concepts.description: time direction indicating that a calendar-specified date is the nth date from the end of a calendar period

concepts.label: from the start
concepts.description: time direction indicating that a calendar-specified date is the nth day from the beginning of a calendar period.

concepts.label: front
concepts.description: side or part of a building that presents itself to view first, that faces the street; the most forward part of a building

concepts.label: full amortization
concepts.description: amortization in which the very last payment (which, if the schedule was calculated correctly, should be equal to all others) pays off all remaining principal and interest on the loan

concepts.label: full faith credit bond
concepts.description: bond secured by an unconditional promise to pay by another entity

concepts.label: fully amortizing asset-backed security
concepts.description: asset-backed security based on a pool of debt instruments that returns principal to investors over the life of the security

concepts.label: fully-indexed interest rate
concepts.description: a variable interest rate that is calculated by adding a margin to a specified index rate

concepts.label: fully paid share
concepts.description: share whose payment status indicates that no additional money is owed to the company by shareholders on the value of the shares

concepts.label: fully paid share status
concepts.description: status indicating that no additional money is owed to the company by shareholders on the value of the shares

concepts.label: functional business entity
concepts.description: functional entity defined in terms of the nature of the commercial activity it conducts

concepts.label: functional entity
concepts.description: party defined in terms of a function they or it performs

concepts.label: functional role
concepts.description: role representing an underlying functionality that something, such as a person, organization, process, or service, is expected to perform or deliver

concepts.label: fund administrator
concepts.description: role of the party responsible for managing the operational, accounting, and compliance functions of an investment fund

concepts.label: fund contract
concepts.description: contract that embodies and defines the fund legal form in cases where there is no independent organization

concepts.label: fund family
concepts.description: collection of managed investments that are all managed by a single investment institution

concepts.label: fund holder
concepts.description: party that owns units in or a percentage of and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some fund, provided in exchange for investment

concepts.label: fund holding
concepts.description: ownership interest in a fund, which may represented by fund units that confer financial rights and governance privileges

concepts.label: fund manager
concepts.description: role of the party responsible for making investment decisions and managing the portfolio of an investment fund

concepts.label: fund of funds
concepts.description: investment fund that invests directly in other investment funds rather than investing in stocks, bonds, and other securities

concepts.label: fund position
concepts.description: position in some fund, which may be defined in terms of fund units

concepts.label: fund unit
concepts.description: quantified share of beneficial interest in a pooled fund, representing a proportional claim on the fund's assets, income, or entitlements

concepts.label: funds
concepts.description: artificial currency used as calculation basis for another currency(s) and accounting purposes

concepts.label: funds identifier
concepts.description: sequence of characters that can be used to uniquely identify funds

concepts.label: fungible token
concepts.description: digital token capable of mutual substitution between the individual units of digital assets

concepts.label: future
concepts.description: derivative instrument that obligates the buyer to receive and the seller to deliver the assets specified at an agreed price, at some later point in time

concepts.label: future on future
concepts.description: futures contract whose underlying asset is at least one (other) futures contract

concepts.label: future on option
concepts.description: futures contract whose underlying asset is at least one option contract

concepts.label: future on swap
concepts.description: futures contract whose underlying asset is at least one swap contract

concepts.label: futures commission merchant
concepts.description: party that does both of the following: (1) solicits or accepts orders to buy or sell futures contracts, options on futures, retail off-exchange forex contracts, or swaps and (2) accepts money or other assets from customers to support such orders

concepts.description: loan to one or more individuals for household, family, or other personal expenditures in which the borrower pledges some asset via a security agreement as collateral for the loan, or that is secured via third-party guarantee

concepts.label: secured loan
concepts.description: loan in which the borrower pledges some asset via a security agreement as collateral for the loan, or that is secured via third-party guarantee

concepts.label: Securities and Exchange Commission
concepts.description: independent commission established by the Securities Act of 1933 and Securities Exchange Act of 1934 whose mission is to protect investors, maintain fair, orderly, and efficient markets, and facilitate capital formation

concepts.label: securities and exchange regulator
concepts.description: regulatory agency and registration authority role of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

concepts.label: securities basket constituent
concepts.description: security identified as a component of a basket of securities

concepts.label: securities offering
concepts.description: offering of a security (or securities) for sale

concepts.label: securities pool
concepts.description: pool of securities organized for the purpose of issuing notes against those securities

concepts.label: securities regulation
concepts.description: regulation codified in law specific to securities and investments

concepts.label: securities restriction
concepts.description: legal obligation that is applicable to a financial instrument or listing as mandated in a law or by contract

concepts.label: securities transaction
concepts.description: transaction between two or more parties involving the exchange of commonly defined financial products

concepts.label: security
concepts.description: financial instrument that can be bought or sold

concepts.label: security agreement
concepts.description: collateral agreement that grants a financial interest in some collateral to a party that is not an owner of that collateral, specifying terms including relative duties and rights, over and above those specified in the primary contract, regarding the disposition of the asset used as collateral

concepts.label: security-based derivative
concepts.description: derivative instrument whose underlier is based on a security, including collections of securities and indices based on securities

concepts.label: security form
concepts.description: nature of the proof of ownership of a security

concepts.label: security identification scheme
concepts.description: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers

concepts.label: security identifier
concepts.description: any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security

concepts.label: security price
concepts.description: monetary price for a financial instrument at some point in time

concepts.label: security registry
concepts.description: registry used to manage security identifiers and related information

concepts.label: security registry entry
concepts.description: record for a security in a securities registry

concepts.label: security underwriter
concepts.description: party that has purchased from an issuer with a view to, or sells for an issuer in connection with, the distribution of any security, or participates or has a direct or indirect participation in any such undertaking, or participates or has a participation in the direct or indirect underwriting of ...

concepts.label: security underwriting arrangement
concepts.description: underwriting agreement between an organization (typically an investment bank) and a securities issuer that commits the underwriter to assuming risk involved in buying a new issue of securities and reselling it to the public

concepts.label: self-regulating organization
concepts.description: non-governmental organization that has the power to create and exercise some degree of regulatory authority over an industry or profession in some country or group of countries

concepts.label: seller
concepts.description: party that makes, offers or contracts to make a sale to an actual or potential buyer

concepts.label: Seoul
concepts.description: the international business center of Seoul

concepts.label: Serbian entity
concepts.description: sovereign state and polity that is Serbia

concepts.label: service
concepts.description: intangible activity performed by some party for the benefit of another party

concepts.label: service agreement
concepts.description: written contract between a client and service provider whereby the service provider supplies some service in the form of time, effort, and/or expertise in exchange for compensation

concepts.label: service provider
concepts.description: role of an agent that provides some service, including but not limited to commercial or professional services

concepts.label: settlement
concepts.description: act of finalizing a transaction, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable

concepts.label: settlement auction
concepts.description: independently administered synthetic auction process on a set of defined deliverable obligations that sets the reference final price that can be used to facilitate cash settlement of all covered transactions following a credit event

concepts.label: settlement convention
concepts.description: convention employed to determine the closing date (from the stated settlement date) in the process of settling a transaction on which securities or interests in securities are delivered, usually against (in simultaneous exchange for) payment of some consideration

concepts.label: settlement date rule
concepts.description: convention for determining settlement dates by reference to some jurisdiction or as set by a given exchange or similar venue

concepts.label: settlement event
concepts.description: specific event involving the finalization a transaction or portion thereof, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable

concepts.label: settlement netting provision
concepts.description: netting provision that specifies the way in which on a given payment date, each party will aggregate the amounts of a currency to be delivered by it, and only the difference in the aggregate amounts will be delivered by the party with the larger aggregate obligation

concepts.label: settlement terms
concepts.description: contract terms that define the commitment to and mechanism for settling one or more sides of a transaction

concepts.label: Shanghai

concepts.label: share

concepts.label: share issuer
concepts.description: issuer of securities that represent an ownership interest in something

concepts.label: share payment status

concepts.label: share yield

concepts.label: shareholder

concepts.label: shareholders' equity
